steps.content: All those "Rustfire Sinners" got pummeled to a pulp. Donald tears off some of their cloaks—most are wearing gangster clothes underneath.
Beep beep... Beep beep...

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: Sergeant Donald, the Headquarters ordered everyone to retreat. Where are you? Did you leave already?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: <size=28>Oh s*** I forgot...</size> Ahem, I'm on my way.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: Which way are you on exactly? How long do you still need? You're heavily injured, why are you still...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ooh there's gunfire! I think I hear a grenade! The signal here's not good, you're cutting off! I won't be able to make it back for at least a few days! Hold down the fort for me!

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: Sergeant...
He hangs up the comms with a scowl and lets out a sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Rustfire" Gangster
steps.content: You're a f***** exec...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Don't say that. Anyone who wears this cloak belongs to Rustfire, remember?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I think you should... Get some rest!
Bonk—the man gets knocked unconscious.
A man in tattered clothes walks over. His posture and eyes are dodgy, but he shows no malice.

steps.speaker: Person in Tattered Clothes
steps.content: Is... is it safe to go?
Donald nods, and goes back to the two girls. The manic girl has finally come back to her senses.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm sorry... I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Sigh... How did those bastards brainwash this little girl...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's still a bit slow, but she is healing as quick as she can. Instead of apologizing, you just need to cheer her on.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But... Chief is still...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief ran into trouble, yet I'm not by his side... I couldn't find him... couldn't save him...
steps.female_content: Chief ran into trouble, yet I'm not by her side... I couldn't find her... couldn't save her...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I couldn't...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Is that Chief someone really important to you?
Hecate freezes, then nods slowly.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Then I'll go bring him back. You kids go with this man to a safe place first.
steps.female_content: Then I'll go bring her back. You kids go with this man to a safe place first.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Stop apologizing. Just remember to thank me when I get back. Then, you can say to your "Chief"... Let me think...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: "Welcome back," or... "You baddy, don't make me so worried about you ever again!"
